data.semantics: decoded observed words, never lifecycle assertions; actual occurrence provenance and acquisition map supplied independently

original_words.shape: word_order from RAW-INTERFACE; each value two observed scalar bits in0,1,N; 00u 01v 10sourcecomplement 11invalid

W_R.shape: three observed scalar bits plus one observed present bit, each0,1,N; actual outputs668..683

data.absent_acquisition: retain entire intended attempt with missing observands; partial words retained; no replacement by late attempt
data.diagnostic_projection: native.validate_native_diagnostics takes only the fixed decoded code/ternary arrays plus actual_n/completed decoded FROM original endpoint words, never caller lifecycle flags
data.permitted_non_evidential_envelope: predeclared attempt/case index and immutable raw occurrence provenance; neither expected case nor filename supplies actual settings/count/body/event values

comparisons.tokens: all128 source+destination values and exact convention; source10 and anyN/11 remain failure
comparisons.events: tag_i = i<actual requested n; flag_done31..40 and events41..62 all1; event63=0; this is SUCCESS comparison, not seal firing guard
comparisons.offer: present1, valid65-bit count strictly below actual printed cutoff; cutoff tie fails
comparisons.original_semantic_word_anomalies: code-valid original STOP!=1 or completed_count!=actual_n retains acquired angular/endpoint category AND forbidden; NOT acquisition unavailable when independent code/token/identity/event/offer/seal checks pass
comparisons.actual_n_tag_pattern: actual_n versus observed tag-event pattern mismatch IS acquisition-invalid; coherent wrong actual_n+count+tag pattern versus scheduled case remains category+forbidden
comparisons.all_attempts: wrong-valid settings retain actual category and forbidden mark; no success conditioning

integer_encoding: Integers whose magnitude exceeds 2^53-1 are decimal strings in this derivative reference; preserve with arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic. Exact rationals remain strings. This encoding does not alter the separately defined raw-record JSON type contract.
